# Design

Four independent slices, one wave, each in its own file so the merge is mechanical. Progress (src/progress.c): a Progress struct owned by the main thread of index_pass; the ring consumer ticks it per file, the walk ticks it per directory, the gate and lock waits tick it with what they wait for; it renders with \\r and clear-to-end on a tty and plain lines under CG_PROGRESS=plain; a quiet or background IndexOpts leaves it off. Journal (src/journal.c): journal_append(cg, op, json) writes <ms>-<pid>-<seq>.json under .codegraph/journal/ via a temp file and rename; journal_replay(cg) takes a flock on the directory, reads the records in name order, dispatches each op (memory.add, event.emit, lease.release, attempt.finish, handoff.add, work.update) through the same functions the commands use, and unlinks or moves it; cg_begin_write calls journal_replay on success, cg_open calls it when a BEGIN IMMEDIATE succeeds at once; the busy branch of each listed command calls journal_append instead of cg_busy_report. Workers (src/config.c, src/syncgate.c): CFG_INDEX_WORKERS joins CFG_KEYS; config_index_workers(root) returns 0 for auto; syncgate_worker_budget applies flag, environment, config, and sysinfo in that order against a 64 cap, and records the origin for cg info. Help (src/help.c): a static Command table — group, name, usage, summary, detail, flags, related — drives help_overview, help_command, help_all, and help_json; main's usage() becomes a call into it and its bad-argument usage lines read the table.
